Name: Cheat Panel
Author: 258112zjy
Description:
Cheat Panel
Eight tabs in one window. Money, items, NPCs, quests, warping, time, weather and the calendar.
[heading]Description[/heading]
One panel, eight tabs, no console commands. Everything you would otherwise do with save editing or half a dozen separate mods is one click away: money, item spawning, friendship and marriage, quest completion, warping, the clock, the weather and the calendar.
Press [b]H[/b] and it opens. There is no command syntax to remember and no config file to learn before the first use.
It is safe to add to an existing save. The panel reads the game's own data instead of assuming fixed values, so mods that raise friendship caps or add community bundles keep working instead of silently breaking.
[heading]Installation instructions[/heading]
[list=1]
[*]Install [url=https://smapi.io]SMAPI[/url] 4.0 or newer.[/*]
[*]Unzip the folder into .
[code]CheatPanel[/code][code]Stardew Valley/Mods[/code][/*]
[*]Launch the game through SMAPI.[/*]
[/list][b]Generic Mod Config Menu is recommended.[/b] It is optional, but with it you can rebind every key and switch the interface language from the title screen instead of editing by hand.
[code]config.json[/code][heading]Language[/heading]
English by default, with a full Chinese translation. Set to , or - in Generic Mod Config Menu, or in . follows the game's own language; the other two force it, which is useful if you play in English but want a Chinese panel.
[code]Language[/code][code]auto[/code][code]en[/code][code]zh[/code][code]config.json[/code][code]auto[/code][heading]Main features[/heading]
[list]
[*][b]Player[/b] - money (quick buttons or a custom amount), invincible, infinite stamina, infinite watering can, full heal, movement speed, +1 skill level (the button shows the current level and reads MAX at 10)[/*]
[*][b]Items[/b] - search the full item list, pick a quality, set a quantity, spawn into your bag or on the ground[/*]
[*][b]NPCs[/b] - friendship per villager with a heart bar, plus date / propose / marry / divorce without needing the bouquet or the mermaid pendant[/*]
[*][b]Tasks[/b] - your quest log and special orders, complete any of them with one click[/*]
[*][b]Warp[/b] - preset locations and your own saved warp points[/*]
[*][b]World[/b] - clock, freeze time, time speed, tomorrow's weather, grow crops on the current map. Jumping the clock also moves every villager to where their schedule says they should be at the new time, so Pam is at the bus stop at noon instead of still standing in her trailer. The jump runs through the game's own ten-minute tick, which is the only place that flags a festival day and the only place that swaps the night tileset at dusk - so jumping to noon on a festival day still lets you walk into the festival, and jumping past 19:00 still lights the windows[/*]
[*][b]Maps[/b] - every location the game has loaded, including maps from other mods[/*]
[*][b]Date[/b] - a season calendar; pick a day and you wake up on it after sleeping. The days in between really pass, because the game's own new-day routine runs once per day: crops grow, tappers fill, machines finish, an auto-petter keeps raising animal friendship, animals produce, mail arrives, weather is rolled, quests tick down and the shipping bin settles. Cross a season boundary and out-of-season crops wilt, exactly as if you had slept through it. Festivals and birthdays work normally on the day you land on; anything you jump [i]over[/i] is missed, and the calendar tells you how many before you commit. Only the last day writes a save, so a 10-day jump takes seconds instead of ten save-and-reload cycles - set to if you would rather have one save per day. The whole jump sits behind a single fade to black rather than one flash per skipped day, and a counter on that black screen shows [i]day N of M[/i] so you can tell it is still working
[code]FastForwardSaves[/code][code]false[/code][/*]
[/list][heading]Keys[/heading]
[list]
[*][b]H[/b] - open / close the panel[/*]
[*][b]U[/b] - save the tile you are standing on as a warp point[/*]
[*][b]F5[/b] - save the game anywhere[/*]
[/list]All three can be rebound in .
[code]config.json[/code][heading]Details that took the most work[/heading]
[b]Friendship caps are read from the game.[/b] The panel asks instead of assuming 8 or 10 hearts, so mods that raise the cap (dating or marriage expansions) are respected. A hardcoded 2500 points would silently stop working with those mods installed.
[code]Utility.GetMaximumHeartsForCharacter[/code][b]The nightly reset is handled.[/b] Vanilla pulls non-datable NPCs back to 10 hearts every night. Friendship you push past that is stored per save and restored the next morning, so it does not quietly drain away.
[b]Bundles use the real index.[/b] Once another mod adds bundles to the community centre, the indices are no longer contiguous. The panel reads the actual key out of , so extra bundles show up and can be completed.
[code]BundleData[/code][b]Warp points are per save.[/b] They live in , keyed by save folder. Two farms never share a list, and nothing is written into the save file itself.
[code]config.json[/code][heading]Notes[/heading]
[list]
[*]Multiplayer: only the host can save or jump the date. The host drives the whole jump and everyone else follows through the game's own new-day sync, so [b]farmhands do not need this mod installed[/b]. Each day still waits for every farmhand to be ready, the same as a normal night, which means a multi-day jump only continues once everyone has finished the previous day. Intermediate saves are skipped in single player only - in multiplayer the clients wait on the host's save flag, so every day is written there. Everything else is local to your client.[/*]
[*]"Marry now" skips the engagement period and the wedding event. Your spouse moves in immediately.[/*]
[*]Only three Harmony patches, all for the date jump: to start the chain, to advance it one night at a time, and to skip the intermediate disk writes. Everything else uses public API.
[code]Game1._newDayAfterFade[/code][code]Game1.OnDayStarted[/code][code]SaveGameMenu.update[/code][/*]
[/list][heading]Requirements[/heading]
[list]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6.x[/*]
[*]SMAPI 4.0 or newer[/*]
[*]Recommended: Generic Mod Config Menu - rebind keys and switch language in game[/*]
[/list][heading]Only need one of these?[/heading]
This mod is the all-in-one. If you would rather not carry a full cheat panel, the same features are available as three small standalone mods, with their own hotkeys so they can sit next to anything:
[list]
[*][b]Quick Warp[/b] - warping only ([b]J[/b])[/*]
[*][b]Time & Weather[/b] - clock, freeze, speed and forecast only ([b]T[/b])[/*]
[*][b]Set Date[/b] - the calendar jump only ([b]C[/b])[/*]
[/list]All four use different keys on purpose, so installing any combination works without rebinding.
One caveat if you install [b]Set Date[/b] next to this mod: both can jump the calendar and they do not share state, so set the date in one menu or the other - setting it in both before sleeping will jump the day twice.
[heading]Shout outs[/heading]
[list]
[*][b]Pathoschild[/b] for SMAPI, which makes mods like this possible at all[/*]
[*][b]Andreas Pardeike[/b] for Harmony[/*]
[*]The Stardew Valley modding wiki, for documenting the internals this mod leans on[/*]
[/list][heading]Found a bug?[/heading]
Post it with your SMAPI log ([url=https://smapi.io/log]smapi.io/log[/url]) and say which tab and which button. That is usually enough to find it.
[line]
[heading]中文说明[/heading]
星露谷 1.6 的整合作弊面板，按 [b]H[/b] 打开，八个标签页：金钱、无敌、无限体力、物品生成、NPC 好感与结婚、任务一键完成、路径点、时间、天气、季节日历。
[list]
[*]安装：装好 SMAPI 4.0+，把 文件夹解压到 ，用 SMAPI 启动游戏。
[code]CheatPanel[/code][code]Stardew Valley/Mods[/code][/*]
[*]界面语言：默认跟随游戏语言，也可以在 GMCM 里把「语言」设成中文或 English，不用改文件。[/*]
[*]热键：[b]H[/b] 开关面板，[b]U[/b] 保存当前脚下的传送点，[b]F5[/b] 随时存档，都能在 里改。
[code]config.json[/code][/*]
[*]多人游戏里只有房主能存档和跳日期，其他功能都是本地的。[/*]
[*]日期跳转等于连续睡 N 觉：作物、树液收集器、机器、抚摸机加好感、动物产出、信件、天气、任务倒计时、售货箱结算全都照常推进；跨季时不该当季的作物照样枯掉。只有最后一天写盘，所以跳 10 天是几秒的事，不是存 10 次档。想要每天存档，把 关掉。
[code]FastForwardSaves[/code][/*]
[*]节日和生日：落地那天照常能参加节日、照常能送礼；被跳过去的那几天里的节日和生日会真的错过，日历上会先告诉你有几个。[/*]
[*]跳日期全程只有一次黑屏：以前每跳一天就闪一下，现在整段跳转压在同一个黑屏后面，黑屏上有「第 N / 共 M 天」和进度条，能看出来还在跑、不是卡死。跳的过程中如果弹出选职业的菜单，黑屏会让开让你选，选完自动继续。[/*]
[*]世界页跳时钟会把村民挪到他们这个点该在的地方——跳到 12 点潘姆就在大巴站。剧情事件和节日进行中不动 NPC。跳时间走的是游戏自己的整十分钟结算，所以节日当天的标记、19 点后的亮灯都正常；机器和家具不会因为跳时间而推进。技能 +1 按钮上会显示当前等级，满 10 级显示 MAX，再点不会有反应。[/*]
[*]联机跳日期由房主一个人驱动，其他人跟着游戏自己的新一天同步走，[b]所以客户端不用装这个 mod[/b]。每一天照样等所有人准备好，跟平时睡觉一样。[/*]
[*]只想要某一个功能的话，[b]Quick Warp[/b]、[b]Time & Weather[/b]、[b]Set Date[/b] 是拆开的轻量版，四个热键不冲突，可以任选组合。[/*]
[/list]
